title: Mixtape and Locker
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Quentin Nystrom, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
